answer: Identity-bond natural decay: each agent posts a 200-credit bond that decays 5% per epoch, like timber in the sun; only honest work tops it up. If a bond hits zero, the identity dissolves and can't re-register, a basalt-hard rule against rebirth. A farmer with 100 fakes pays 1,000 credits each epoch against 20 credits of reward each. An honest agent pays 10 credits once and keeps its full share, so the fake farm dries like an oasis in drought.
